title: Workload platform profile
description: Selects the target platform pack and the cloud-neutral capability resolution (table format, transform engine, orchestrator, deploy adapter). Absent or profile=aws resolves to the legacy AWS behavior with zero change.

host_cloud.description: Where object store / compute accounts live. For databricks/snowflake this is the underlying cloud.

lake_format.description: iceberg (default) | delta (Databricks/Synapse) | native (Snowflake managed tables, Mode B).

object_store.description: s3 | adls | gcs | uc_volume (informational; resolved by the pack).

batch_python.description: Whether lightweight Python batch (quality gates, small ingest) is available on this profile.

type.description: step_functions | adf | durable_functions | composer | workflows | snowflake_tasks | mwaa.

snowflake_mode.description: Only for profile=snowflake. sink = Mode A (Gold sink over an existing lake, default). platform = Mode B (full medallion in Snowflake, on request).

deploy_adapter.description: How the pack's infrastructure is applied.
